Support

Keep your attention on the work.

Answers to common questions about the Mac App Store version of NanaFlow. If your issue isn't covered, report it directly.

How do I start or pause?

Use the play or pause button in the main window, or open quick controls from the menu bar. Both surfaces stay in sync.

Why is there no window after launch?

NanaFlow is a menu-bar app with no Dock icon. Click the countdown at the top of the screen and choose Show Timer. You can reopen the timer there after closing its window. macOS 15 or later is required.

Where are statistics?

Select the bar-chart button in the main window, then switch between day, week, month, and year. Hover over a bar to see its value.

Where is my focus data stored?

Session data used for statistics and settings stay on your Mac. No account is required. The Mac App Store version currently has no history-list or backup/import interface.

Why is today's count missing in the menu bar?

Open Settings → Menu Bar and enable Show Today's Completed Count. It then appears in a compact form such as “25:00 | 3”.

Where do keyboard shortcuts work?

While NanaFlow is active, use Space to control the timer and ⌘, to open Settings. The current store interface has no way to enable global shortcuts; a new installation does not offer that configuration.

Why did a notification appear without sound?

App preferences and macOS notification and sound settings both affect completion alerts. Check the app's notification toggle, sound selection and volume, plus the system output's mute setting. Actual sound playback in some environments still needs follow-up verification; adjusting volume alone is not a confirmed fix. If it continues, report your app version, macOS version and whether a completion notification appeared. Private session records are not needed.

How do I download and update?

Download NanaFlow free on the Mac App Store and use the store for official updates. Version 1.0.1 was approved and released on November 2, 2026. Both the Chinese and U.S. store listings now show the update.

1.0.1 refines window edges, dragging, menu localization and version information, adds count/net-focus-time selection and separate completion sounds, and improves notification scheduling. See About NanaFlow for your installed version.

The GitHub public beta is a separate test channel with a different version and feature scope. Include your installation source when reporting an issue.

Report an issue

Open a GitHub issue with your macOS version, NanaFlow version, and reproduction steps. Do not attach a full backup containing private session titles.
